title: Transactional email
description: Resend-shaped sendEmail callable plus onOrderPaid receipt when an order becomes paid.

markers.block:
export { sendEmail } from './callable/sendEmail';
export { onOrderPaid } from './triggers/onOrderPaid';

notes: Production: firebase functions:secrets:set RESEND_API_KEY. EMAIL_FROM goes in functions/.env (defineString).
To swap Resend for SendGrid/Postmark: add a SENDGRID_API_KEY (or similar) secret and optional API base URL param; keep the callable contract stable.
